noIssuesMsg:
The built-in rules found no formula problems.
It is still worth double-checking important calculations and business assumptions yourself.
aiDisputed: Assistant thinks it may be fine · please check
reviewNote: This issue stays in the report. The assistant's view is only a hint, not proof that the formula is right.
previewFailed: Could not read this part of the workbook.
aiInvite: These results come from built-in rules and are ready to use. Want a second check? Install the Formula assistant.

suggestionOverrides.CIRCULAR_REFERENCE: Remove the reference to this cell from its own formula. Only turn on Excel's iterative calculation for financial models that really need it.

workspace.sourceChanged: The workbook changed after scanning. Open it again to run a new scan.
workspace.notRecalculated: Read from the saved workbook; not recalculated by CellSentry.
workspace.aiIsOpinion: An assistant opinion does not replace your judgment. The rule finding is retained.
workspace.localDraft: Decisions are saved only in this app on this computer. Export a report to share them.
workspace.aiInProgress: Rules are ready. Local AI review is still running.
workspace.draftFailed: Could not save the local draft. Keep this window open and export your review.
workspace.changeFilter: Change the filters to see other findings.
workspace.selectFinding: Select a finding to inspect its evidence.
workspace.aiFailed: Local AI did not finish. Rule findings and your decisions remain available.
workspace.exportCancelled: Export cancelled. Your review is retained.
workspace.noReportRows: There are no findings in this report scope.
workspace.copyCaveat: A separate annotated copy. Complex workbook features may not be preserved.
